richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Burhanpur

c: Burhanpur is an old city on the Tapti river in south-western Madhya Pradesh, right on the Maharashtra border. It is known for its powerloom industry and the banana farms around it. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Burhanpur to schools, colleges, municipal gardens, powerloom and industrial units, and residential colonies. Our factory in Vasai is about 410 km away, which makes Burhanpur one of the nearer towns we serve in central India.

Being close to Maharashtra helps. The road from our factory runs through Jalgaon district, and a site visit is easier to plan than for towns deeper in the state. The Tapti valley has very hot summers and a fair monsoon, and the ground is often black cotton soil. For that kind of ground we use deeper grouted footings, so the machines stay level as the soil swells and shrinks between seasons.

items.q: Can your team visit a site in Burhanpur?
items.a: Burhanpur is close to the Maharashtra border, so a visit can be planned more easily than for distant towns. Call +91 902 830 2266 to discuss your site.

items.q: How do the machines stay level on black cotton soil?
items.a: We grout each post into a deeper concrete footing that sits below the layer that swells and cracks. This keeps the machine steady through wet and dry seasons.
